route_note: Take a train from Colombo Fort (about 2 to 2.5 hours, the coastal line) or an express bus via the Southern Expressway (about 2 hours), then take a tuk-tuk or walk about 15 to 20 minutes from the station to Galle Fort.
Take a direct train from Colombo Fort (about 3 hours through the hill country) and then a tuk-tuk into the centre, which is a few minutes from Kandy station.
see: Temple of the Tooth (Sri Dalada Maligawa)
Royal Botanic Gardens, Peradeniya (short tuk-tuk ride)

route_note: Take a train from Colombo Fort to Negombo station (about 1 hour) or a bus from the Pettah bus station (about 1 to 1.5 hours), then walk or take a tuk-tuk to the fish market and beach.
